n: the positive integer exponent whose possible values are to be determined
a: the first positive integer variable in the target equation
b: the second positive integer variable in the target equation
c: the third positive integer variable in the target equation
a_1: the positive integer a/2 used in the descent for n at least 3
b_1: the positive integer b/2 used in the descent for n at least 3
c_1: the positive integer c/2 used in the descent for n at least 3
u: the positive integer x/2 in the n=2 case
v: the positive integer y/2 in the n=2 case
w: the positive integer y/3 in the descent when n=2
d: the positive greatest common divisor of a, b, and c
t: an arbitrary odd integer in the odd-square congruence argument
X: the positive integer x/2 used when n=2
Y: the positive integer y/2 used when n=2
